deterministic_cost.status: adopted by maintainer decision 2026-10-12, before outcomes
deterministic_cost.cost: cumulative allocation-stream charged_rays / sample_count per region; undefined before the region's first sample
deterministic_cost.unchanged: kernel elapsed-time measurement retained for end-to-end accounting; equal-cost ablation unchanged
deterministic_cost.consequence: all policies deterministic; three timing repeats must yield bit-identical images (determinism check)

time_estimand.run_end: later of final quality checkpoint A_u + 2^26 committed and common wall cap C
time_estimand.snapshot_cadence: every 2^20 charged rays after initialization; write time inside measured wall time
time_estimand.scoring: offline after the run; no live metric stopping
time_estimand.attainment: first snapshot meeting the joint target; sustained via later snapshots up to C
time_estimand.cap_rule: C = 2 x projected uniform wall time to A_u + 2^26 on the slowest-calibrated non-primary fixture class, fixed before outcomes on the selected host

dispatch.persistent_worker: one PBRT process per stream with a request loop; same qualified instrumentation; requires re-running the native-validation matrix under a new contract
dispatch.vectorized_state: NumPy sufficient statistics with exact-equivalence tests against hash-bound progressive_kernel.py

permanent: per-dispatch aggregate record with hashes of transient logs
retention.transient: per-sample, event and Film CSVs after validation
retention.audit_subset: 1 in 1024 dispatches selected by SHA-256(unit|policy|stream|dispatch), retained in full

next_step_if_adopted.scope: single-job PBRT build; native-validation fixtures with the persistent worker; non-primary throughput, dispatch latency, peak RSS, retained bytes per sample
